name: Chiffon no Mise PUKKU (シフォンのお店 PUKKU)
reasoning: I set out to disprove the record's core claim that 'no wheat is baked on premises,' and the shop's OWN published ingredient page disproves it outright: PUKKU's クッキー, ガレット・ブルトンヌ and バターサンドクッキー are all made with 薄力粉 (wheat cake flour), and its cookie boxes carry the declared allergen set 卵・乳・小麦・くるみ — wheat is mixed and baked daily in the same small patisserie kitchen as the rice-flour chiffon, with no allergen or cross-contact statement published anywhere. The 米粉/グルテンフリー wording in every source is scoped to the chiffon and 100年しふぉん products only (an ingredient claim, 小麦粉不使用, not a facility or celiac claim), and it all traces to the shop's own PR — narakko, nara-gourmet and atpress are promotional echoes of one source, not independent GF verification. There is zero celiac-grade corroboration: PUKKU appears on no FindMeGlutenFree, HappyCow, Atly or gluten-free-japan listing, so no celiac has ever reported eating here safely (equally, I found no 'got glutened' report — the record simply has no celiac evidence in either direction). The chiffon itself is genuinely wheat-free by ingredient (卵・米粉・牛乳・きび砂糖・米油・レモン果汁), which is why this lands at options rather than ask, but 'high' is not defensible for a shop that bakes wheat flour alongside it.
red_flags: RECORD CONTAINS A FALSE SAFETY CLAIM: gf_detail says 'No wheat is baked on premises' — the shop's own 原材料 page lists 薄力粉 (wheat cake flour) in クッキー, ガレット・ブルトンヌ and バターサンドクッキー. This sentence must be rewritten before the record ships.
Shared kitchen: wheat flour is handled and baked on site daily; airborne flour CC risk for a celiac is real and unmitigated.
Cookie boxes / icing cookies / galettes declare allergens 卵・乳・小麦・くるみ; the shop sells these over the same counter as the chiffon.
No published allergen, cross-contact or celiac protocol of any kind — not on the site, not on the ingredient page, not on the ordering pages.
Zero celiac-grade sources: no FindMeGlutenFree, HappyCow, Atly, Vegewel or gluten-free-japan listing exists for this shop.
All five sources on the record trace back to the shop's own PR/promotional material (atpress release, local gourmet media) — not independent GF verification.
GF wording is 小麦粉不使用 (wheat-FLOUR-free), an ingredient statement, and is scoped to the chiffon line only — never to the shop, the cafe, or the lunch.

まんPUKKUランチ is NOT documented gluten-free: mains include 米粉のチキン南蛮 (deep-fried, nanban vinegar sauce + tartare) and 生姜焼き-style pork — soy sauce is wheat by default and the fryer is shared. Miso soup may use barley miso. None of this is verified.
メレンゲクッキー contains アーモンドパウダー but no flour — incidental, not evidence of GF policy.
Deep-frying on premises for the lunch service = shared-oil risk independent of the flour issue.
plain_rice: Yes, but only as part of the reserved まんPUKKUランチ set, which comes with 3種類のミニおにぎり (three mini onigiri) and miso soup — the onigiri fillings/seasonings and the miso are undocumented, so this is not a reliable plain-rice fallback. There is no plain unseasoned gohan sold on its own.
